Ava: Heads-up: scheduling a conservative rollout of llmroute-v4 tomorrow 08:00 UTC using feature flag `llmroute_v4` and an ephemeral cohort `slowspin-01`. Plan: 0.5% -> 3% (hold) -> 15% -> 50% -> 100%. Keep a hard rollback pin available.

Ken: Agree. Telemetry gates at each hold: p50/p95 latency, 1m error rate, token cost delta, and short sample of top prompts for QA. Thresholds: p95 +100ms OR error_rate >0.6% OR cost delta >25% -> trigger mitigation.

Rina: Mitigation flow: 1) reduce cohort to 1% for 5m and notify #eng-oncall; 2) if not recovered -> pin routing to llmroute-v3 and drain cohort. Quick rollback command in runbook.

Ava: Deploy commands:```
# create cohort
rb ff create-cohort llmroute_v4 slowspin-01 --region prod-us
rb ff set llmroute_v4 --cohort slowspin-01 --weight 0.5
# emergency pin to stable
rb ff set llmroute_v4 --cohort global --weight 0
rb route set default --model llmroute-v3
```

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled at 2025-09-10T08:00:00Z. Canary cohort slowspin-01 created (id: s-01f4). Will post preflight snapshot and metrics at each holdpoint. Automatic conservative-reduce enabled; full pin requires confirm after automated evaluation unless threshold breach severe.

Ken: Please include the preflight token-cost snapshot in the release note and tag CS/SRE. I'll be on watch for the 3% hold.

Rina: I'll prepare the short rollback snippet for the incident runbook and stand by.

Ava: Thanks — will post final rollout notes and release-blurb once deploy-bot posts the preflight. :white_check_mark:
